files.name: solution.json
files.note: Root may be either {"shifts": [...]} or a bare JSON array. No other root-key name is tolerated (load_solution checks 'shifts' only, then falls back to bare list; raises ValueError otherwise).

root_keys.name: shifts
root_keys.note: Also accepted as the top-level array directly (no wrapping object). Must contain exactly 20 objects covering all (shift_name, factory) pairs in SHIFT_STRUCT, each pair appearing exactly once.

fields.name: shift_name
fields.note: Combined with factory to form the primary key used to look up the entry in SHIFT_STRUCT. str(sh.get('shift_name', '')).strip()

fields.name: factory
fields.note: Combined with shift_name to form the primary key. norm_factory(sh.get('factory', ''))

fields.name: blocked
fields.normalization: as_bool: true/1/'是'/'封存'/'yes'/'y' → true; everything else → false
fields.note: Must match SHIFT_STRUCT: 27白(一厂) and 27白(二厂) must be true; all other 18 shifts must be false. Mismatch is a hard constraint violation.

fields.name: hours
fields.note: Preferred path. Length must equal the shift's valid-hour count: 26白=5, all other non-blocked shifts=12. Each element is an object with xiaobao/tunbao/sanliao integer fields. If absent or empty, the evaluator falls through to the aggregate fallback (xiaobao_total / tunbao_total / sanliao_total).

fields.name: xiaobao
fields.note: 小包 truck count for this hour. h.get('xiaobao', 0)

fields.name: tunbao
fields.note: 吨包 truck count for this hour. h.get('tunbao', 0)

fields.name: sanliao
fields.note: 散料 truck count for this hour. h.get('sanliao', 0)

fields.name: xiaobao_total
fields.note: Shift-level aggregate fallback used when 'hours' is absent or empty. Exact chain: sh.get('xiaobao_total', sh.get('xiaobao', 0)). Treated as a single merged hour.

fields.name: train_nodes
fields.note: Number of train nodes dispatched this shift. int(sh.get('train_nodes', 0) or 0). Must be 0 for 二厂 shifts. Sum across all 43% shifts must equal demand['43%']['train']; same for 45%.

fields.name: guluomei_tons
fields.note: Tons reserved for 过瘤胃 in this shift (not dispatched, not subtracted from inventory dispatch). float(sh.get('guluomei_tons', 0) or 0). Enforced only for 43% protein shifts: 26白 ≥ GULUOMEI_26BAI_MIN (≈100), all others ≥ GULUOMEI_LATER_MIN (≈200).

ignored_fields.name: protein
ignored_fields.note: Defined in norm_protein() and mentioned in EXTRACTOR_SPEC, but never read inside evaluate(). The evaluator takes protein entirely from SHIFT_STRUCT keyed by (shift_name, factory). Any value in the submission is silently ignored.

structural_checks: shifts must be a non-empty list (or bare JSON array)
must contain exactly 20 objects — one per (shift_name, factory) pair in SHIFT_STRUCT; missing or unknown pairs are a hard constraint failure
each (shift_name, factory) pair must appear exactly once; duplicates are a hard constraint failure
blocked must match SHIFT_STRUCT: 27白(一厂) and 27白(二厂) must be true; all other 18 shifts must be false
for non-blocked shifts: len(hours) must equal n_hours (26白=5, others=12); hours elements must be non-negative; sum per hour must not exceed HOURLY_CAP[factory]
train_nodes must be 0 for 二厂 shifts; aggregate train_nodes across 43% shifts must equal demand, same for 45%
guluomei_tons for 43% non-blocked shifts: 26白 ≥ GULUOMEI_26BAI_MIN, others ≥ GULUOMEI_LATER_MIN
inventory must remain non-negative and must not exceed INV_LIMIT at every shift boundary
